sourceState: Uncommitted native working-tree preview. Embedded sourceRevision is the parent reference commit; the native production/build checkpoint and supplemental inputs identify actual sources. No clean-release provenance claim.
corrections: Percent-encoded blob digest GET is decoded once before strict digest validation.

Local load/tar BuildKit image references are tried in config then distinct manifest/index order, bounded to two inspections, preserving an addressable config (including zero size) and remote/cache-only behavior.

Darwin native host-available memory is free+inactive kernel pages bounded to physical memory with the actual host page size. This approved estimate differs from legacy Node os.freemem free-only semantics; Docker VM capacity remains an independent bound.

Generic atomic config writes preserve existing parent-directory modes, create missing parents privately and support relative leaf paths with directory fsync. Dedicated private_dir behavior, file0600, atomic replacement and read-modify-write locks remain.

linux/arm64.runtime: Exact final bytes passed all six default strict workflow cases as native ARM64 Linux userspace in the M4 Docker Linux VM: command/snapshot/.env/exact artifact, local image build with addressable reference and size, verified ARM act shell, overlapping two-worker shards/JUnit, cancellation cleanup and doctor. Final custom config-parent permission checks also passed. Separately, exact bytes passed uid65534/read-only/network-disabled Alpine init/TLS/status/graceful stop without separate runtime/compiler tools; the disposable shared tmpfs parent mode was preserved.
